why: Offer = 6.1% x $3,100,000 book equity = $189,100. Broker indication (2026-10-05): enterprise value $14.5M, equity ~$9.8M, so 18% = $1,764,000 and 6.1% = $597,800. The offer is 10.7% of the 18% indication and 31.6% of even the post-dilution 6.1% indication. The dilution is not valid on the current file for two independent reasons. (1) Notice: §6.3 requires written notice 'delivered to each Member by certified mail and email at least 30 days before the due date.' Notice was sent by text message; no certified mail; the email bounced to an address stale since 2019 that the Company itself kept on file — client confirms no letter was ever received. Under Zimmerman v. Crothall, dilution triggers require strict compliance with notice mechanics and stated purpose; this call did not comply, so no Dilution Event occurred and Imani remains at 18%. (2) Arithmetic: even taking the Manager's own inputs (fair value $7.2M; $1,500,000 funded), no standard pro-rata dilution formula produces 6.1%. Value-weighted: 18% x 7.2/(7.2+1.5) = 14.9%; counting only Bram's $1.23M: 18% x 7.2/(7.2+1.23) = 15.4%; capital-account on book: 0.18 x 3.1/(3.1+1.5) = 12.1%. To reach 6.1% at FV $7.2M, new capital would have to be ~$14.05M; or with $1.5M new capital, fair value would have to be ~$0.77M. The 6.1% figure cannot be reconciled to the Manager's stated $7.2M and is left open as unexplained — supporting arbitrariness/bad faith (Zimmerman: value far below a contemporaneous independent indication; broker equity $9.8M is 1.36x the Manager's $7.2M). Manager's $7.2M vs broker $9.8M: $2.6M gap. Also open/unquantified: the '6% of gross rents' fee stream — no rent figures in the file; and whether Bram's payment of Imani's $270,000 share was booked as a loan to the Company or an additional contribution to him. Fee totals paid to Castellan 2022-2026 (asset management only): 180,000+195,000+210,000+225,000+240,000 = $1,050,000 (actual escalations were flat +$15,000/yr, vs 8%/yr in the 2022 resolution which would give 194,400/209,952/226,748/244,888 — a minor discrepancy, noted not forced).
